description: Mo modal 'Display settings' cua Variants, bam 'Edit label' cua COLOR, nhap 'Colour' roi Save

entries.label: mapped

request_body.query: query get { products_by_pk(id: 3203) { id color_custom_label color_display_type colors_position product_options_position size_custom_label size_display_type sizes_position variants(order_by: {id: asc}) { id color size } } }

entries.note: Query nap state cua modal Display settings. Lo ra 7 field cau hinh hien thi option: color_custom_label, color_display_type, colors_position, product_options_position, size_custom_label, size_display_type, sizes_position.

entries.label: mapped

request_body.query: mutation update($id: bigint!, $objects: products_set_input!) { update_products(where: {id: {_eq: $id}}, _set: $objects) { returning { id } } }

entries.note: Save gui ca 5 field mot luc. LUU Y: color_display_type / size_display_type KHONG nam trong payload vi cac radio trong modal deu disabled va khong radio nao checked, du record product co color_display_type='radio'. colors_position/sizes_position la mang thu tu gia tri option, sinh tu danh sach variant.
